brand_name: Step by Step Treatment and Recovery Centers
niche_note: closest match — actual category is sober living / recovery housing; recovery-coach DNA used as base + uplifted to BOUTIQUE_PREMIUM_AFFLUENT register for investor-grade aesthetic
owner_model_reason: Founder-led brand. Yomi Martin is the primary trust anchor. First-person singular voice throughout copy.

audiences_priority.note: Site doubles as Yomi's investor pitch credibility piece — must signal operational excellence + market opportunity
Private-pay decision-makers (residents themselves or family members covering tuition) — affluent, design-aware, values intimacy and dignity

brand_voice: Warm but composed. Direct without being clinical. Hopeful without saccharine wellness language. Speaks to the reader as a peer, not a patient. Plain English. Short paragraphs. Confident understatement.
positioning: St. Louis's first design-forward, boutique-scale (8 residents) sober living residence — a modern home in a real neighborhood, founded and led by Yomi Martin.
brand_register_reason: Audience tier is affluent (investors + private-pay families). Founder explicitly framed the brief as 'very high-end' with 'modern home' aesthetic. References (Rize OC, Serenity Lodge, Caron) all sit in the premium private-pay tier. Brand-name patterns don't force any other register; voice + audience tilt boutique-premium.
differentiation: The home is the brand — modern residence in St. Louis is the visual hero, not stock recovery imagery
Boutique scale (8 residents) — intimacy and design as the premium signal, not amenity volume
St. Louis private-pay market gap — Harris House owns nonprofit/insurance; no premium private-pay sober living exists in St. Louis with this aesthetic
Founder-led trust anchor — Yomi Martin's story is the through-line, not 'our clinical staff'
Dual-audience site with a discrete Investment Opportunity page — invisible to casual visitors, prominent to investors
needs_human_input: Real architectural photography of the modern home (interior + exterior)
Final business address in St. Louis
Final founding-year and entity-type (LLC / Inc / Nonprofit)
Accreditation status (CARF / NARR / state license — current and aspirational)
Investment-pitch concrete details (round size, use of funds, residence count target, financial projections) for the Partner With Us page
tone_constraints: No 'before/after transformation' framing — unethical in mental health context
No countdown timers, urgency scarcity, alarm-red CTAs
No serif display fonts (banned for recovery niche per typography-2026.md)
